Name: Composition Message Registry
Description: This registry defines the messages for composition related events.

ResourceBlockChanged.Description: Indicates that a resource block has changed.  This is not used whenever there is another event message for that specific change, such as when only the state has changed.
ResourceBlockChanged.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that one or more properties of a `ResourceBlock` resource have changed.  This message shall not be used for cases where a more specific message could be used in its place.
ResourceBlockChanged.Message: Resource block '%1' has changed on the service.
ResourceBlockChanged.Example: Resource block 'Block1' has changed on the service.
ArgDescriptions: The `Id` of the resource block that has changed.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the value of the `Id` property of the `ResourceBlock` resource that has changed.

ResourceBlockStateChanged.Description: Indicates that the state of a resource block has changed, specifically the value of the `State` property within `Status`.
ResourceBlockStateChanged.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the `State` property within the `Status` object of a `ResourceBlock` resource has changed.
ResourceBlockStateChanged.Message: The state of resource block '%1' has changed.
ResourceBlockStateChanged.Example: The state of resource block 'Block1' has changed.
ArgDescriptions: The `Id` of the resource block that has changed.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the value of the `Id` property of the `ResourceBlock` resource that has changed.

ResourceBlockCompositionStateChanged.Description: Indicates that the composition state of a resource block has changed, specifically the value of the `CompositionState` property within `CompositionStatus`.
ResourceBlockCompositionStateChanged.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the `CompositionState` property within the `CompositionStatus` object of a `ResourceBlock` resource has changed.
ResourceBlockCompositionStateChanged.Message: The composition status of the resource block '%1' has changed.
ResourceBlockCompositionStateChanged.Example: The composition status of the resource block 'Block1' has changed.
ArgDescriptions: The `Id` of the resource block that has changed.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the value of the `Id` property of the `ResourceBlock` resource that has changed.

ResourceZoneMembershipChanged.Description: Indicates that the membership of a resource zone has changed due to resource blocks being added or removed from the resource zone.
ResourceZoneMembershipChanged.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that entries found in the `ResourceBlocks` array within the `Links` object for a resource zone have been added or removed.
ResourceZoneMembershipChanged.Message: The membership of resource zone '%1' has been changed.
ResourceZoneMembershipChanged.Example: The membership of resource zone 'Zone1' has been changed.
ArgDescriptions: The `Id` of the resource zone that has changed.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the value of the `Id` property of the `Zone` resource that represents the resource zone that has changed.

ResourceBlockInUse.Description: Indicates that the composition request contains a resource block that is unable to participate in more compositions.
ResourceBlockInUse.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the composition request contains a `ResourceBlock` resource that is unable to participate in more compositions due to restrictions specified in its `CompositionStatus` property.  For example, the resource block has reached its composition limit specified by the `MaxCompositions` property.
ResourceBlockInUse.Message: Resource block '%1' cannot be part of any new compositions.
ResourceBlockInUse.Example: Resource block 'Block1' cannot be part of any new compositions.
ArgDescriptions: The `Id` of the resource block that cannot be part of any new compositions.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the value of the `Id` property of the `ResourceBlock` resource that cannot be part of any new compositions.
ResourceBlockInUse.Resolution: Remove the resource block from the request and resubmit the request.
